title: Piper nigrum cream for medicinal use
intro: Piper nigrum cream is a topical preparation made from the ground fruit of the black pepper plant, *Piper nigrum*, combined with a base of oils or creams. It is commonly used in herbalism for its warming and stimulating properties. This cream is applied to the skin to help alleviate pain, improve circulation, and reduce inflammation. It is often used in treatments for muscle aches, joint pain, and colds due to its pungent and aromatic qualities. The active compounds in black pepper, such as piperine, enhance its therapeutic effects when applied externally.
